notes.title: Thanks for playing!
notes.content:
There was a lot of interest in our game this week. Hundreds of players have entered the game. Game rooms were always active. Thank you everyone who plays our game lovingly. Thank you for choosing us to spend your time.

[h1]What should we add to your game?[/h1]

> New maps?
> New guns?
> Knife, Bomb
> All
